authoring_method: Original agent-authored SVG markup, written directly from the approved Buried Coil concept. No image-generation tool or external visual input was used.

concept_basis.original_functional_role: A concealed defensive structure that waits beneath a copper hatch, then rises to aim focused emberseed pulses at nearby intruders.
concept_basis.revealed_form: A short, sturdy lookout tower with a three-footed silhouette, a bright central emberseed, and two thick copper coil rings crowning the mast.

authored_source.authorship_note: Readable original source SVG; includes comments and title/description metadata.

optimization.method: Removed XML comments and whitespace between tags only; no geometry, path coordinates, fill values, or SVG accessibility metadata changed.

supersedes_prior_bitmap_candidate.prior_round2_native_observation: The bitmap builder capture recorded merged lower supports at 13 CSS px; no R2 independent-critic verdict is asserted here.

vector_prototype_reference.note: The R3 prototype captures use the original source SVG before public minification. R4 shortens only the lower foot bases to leave a transparent row over the separate plate. R4 native captures use the unchanged asset-stage fixture and do not claim live arena or card-template integration.
